_about: F7 (CODE_JOB_F7_typologies.md, 8 Nov 2026): the typology library. One entry per typology, in MASTER_PLAN Phase B order. Figures come from each typology's spec (Emergency hub: Claude Link eh/specs/emergency_hub.md, parts 1-4, 9 Nov 2026) with register ids; a typology whose spec has not passed J.B.'s gate shows no figures. Status: specified (spec parts 1-3 final), in progress (spec being written; test-fit boards exist), not started (research file only, checks/research_typ/). Update this file when a spec changes. The three passed specs are published with the tool (J.B., 9 and 10 Nov 2026): tool/f1/specs/<id>.md, verbatim copies; re-copy one when Cowork changes it (checks/tests/spec_sync.js fails until then).
_icons: tool/f1/icons/*.svg (copied from Claude Link docs/icons, first pass, 8 Nov): servers, refuge, clinic, pool, greenhouse. Programs without a drawn model show their name only.

smallLots._about: F7 small-lot floors (J.B., 9 Nov 2026): which typology fits a small lot with a lane. From the Emergency hub spec Part 4 (Claude Link eh/specs/emergency_hub.md, 'Small lot' and 'Near miss 1 drawn on 1360 Frances St', 10 Nov) and the two gate notes of 10 Nov (heat cascade, community pool: small lots point to the Emergency hub V1360). Floors are 'about': our arithmetic on test lots, not a citywide sweep.

rows.note: Under about 530 m² with a lane, none of the three passed typologies fits.

rows.label: Meets code as read; not FM 5-32 (insurer)
rows.note: Generators in a 2-hour room on storey 2 (VBBL 3.6.2.8), transformer alcoves on the street, refuge at grade. Drawn on 1360 Frances St (I-2, 484 m² buildable): fits as drawn, with tight margins. Needs a lane frontage of at least 14.0 m and a street frontage of at least 14.2 m. Heat cascade and community pool: no small-lot version; they point here.
Generators and pads at grade, as FM 5-32 asks. One floor for every typology: about 750 m² with a lane (room minimums alone give about 620 m²; unproven between).

smallLots.noLane: Without a lane: the at-grade versions need about 1,010 m² and at least 26.7 m of frontage. The upstairs variant is not worked out without a lane (?).

notChecked: Plans are hand fits by Cowork, self-checked after the last fixes; the tool checks them again (T-reach, dead ends, room widths, egress doorways: all 8 pass, 9 Nov).
Detailed design is not checked (J.B., 9 Nov): fixture layouts, door swings, intake and exhaust placement, finishes. Results within 0.5 m of a limit are 'tight: check in design'.
Room sizes: most are drawing choices; clinic minimums are an Alberta guideline; CSA Z8000 and TIA-942 are unread.
The 6.0 m hall storey carries every height and MW result and has no source (drawing choice).
Edmonton cooling: the chiller model is outside its maker's stated range at −30 °C: a placeholder.
Noise, air intakes, drains, refrigerant-leak distances, fire access and truck turning are '?' on every fit.
Edmonton hand fits use licensed lot lines, so their plans are not shown here; 64 Airport Rd NW is shown from the tool's own layout on City parcels.
